description:
Han Sua, who has been living a quiet life while keeping her preferences hidden, is often told by those around her that she'd be a good match for a tough guy. However, her actual taste leans toward gentle and cute men.

One day, while enjoying a BL manga featuring a submissive character, she accidentally bumps into "Junwoo," who bears an uncanny resemblance to the dominant character from her story.

Despite him being the opposite of her type, Sua feels an inexplicable attraction to him. A few days later, she runs into Junwoo again, and this time, she notices something unusual about his phone's wallpaper.

Is this tough-looking guy blushing over a cute character on his screen?!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/tricky_lovers), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/tricky_lovers), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000073833), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13304020), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250797)
